jobDescription:
This role supports both the
Accenture Foundation and the
Global Corporate Citizenship Budget team, contributing to the effective execution, financial stewardship, and governance of Accentures corporate citizenship and philanthropic activities. Corporate Citizenship at Accenture focuses on driving positive social impact through strategic investments, partnerships, and programs that advance inclusion, skills development, and economic empowerment in communities around the world.

The Accenture Foundation, Inc. is a U.S.-based, nonprofit organization that advances these objectives by providing grant funding and supporting initiatives that expand access to economic opportunity, with a strong focus on employment, entrepreneurship, and resilience.

Based in India, the role operates in a highly matrixed, global environment and works closely with leaders and partners across regions and time zones.

The position is split
approximately 50% supporting Accenture Foundation operations and
50% supporting global Corporate Citizenship budget management and reporting. The role requires strong financial discipline, operational rigor, and the ability to work independently within established governance frameworks.


Key Responsibilities

Accenture Foundation Support (Approximately 50%)

  • Support the daytoday operations of the Accenture Foundation, including governance, financial administration, and compliance activities
  • Support Board and Committee governance, including preparation, coordination, and review of meeting materials, financial schedules, and tracking of actions and followups
  • Support the grant lifecycle, including documentation, approvals, disbursements, tracking, and reporting, in line with Foundation policies and cash management requirements
  • Prepare and maintain Foundation financial workpapers, supporting quarterly and annual reporting, audits, and governance reviews, and ensuring adherence to established controls and documentation standards
  • Perform bank account reconciliations, investigating and resolving reconciling items in coordination with Finance and external partners, and ensuring timely and accurate cash reporting
  • Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Tax, Audit, and external auditors to support audits, regulatory requirements, and ongoing compliance activities
  • Maintain accurate, organized financial records, trackers, and documentation, supporting transparency, traceability, and effective Foundation governance


Global Corporate Citizenship Budget Team Support (Approximately 50%)

  • Support global Corporate Citizenship budget management processes, including actuals tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis within cash, pro bono, and DNP budgets
  • Coordinate budget inputs from multiple regions and workstreams, including pro bono and market unit support, to ensure accuracy and timeliness
  • Prepare financial summaries, dashboards, and materials for Global Corporate Citizenship leadership and governance forums
  • Support quarterly and ad hoc financial reviews and budget governance processes; provide additional ad hoc operational support as needs arise
  • Ensure alignment with internal financial policies, controls, and approval requirements
  • Identify opportunities to improve budgeting, reporting, and financial governance processes, and support implementation of enhancements
  • Provide flexible support across additional operational and administrative priorities as the role continues to evolve
  • Support global grant tracking in Accenture''s myGrants tool


Key Outcomes

  • Accurate and timely Foundation and Corporate Citizenship financial reporting
  • Highquality, decisionready materials for leadership and governance bodies
  • Strong financial controls, documentation, and audit readiness
  • Reliable execution across recurring budget and governance cycles
  • Effective coordination across global stakeholders with minimal escalation



Qualification


Required Qualifications

  • Experience in operations, finance, budget management, or governancefocused roles
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities with limited supervision
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and execution skills
  • Experience in preparing materials for senior leadership or governance forums
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a global, matrixed environment across time zones
  • Willingness to work second shift India hours


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting foundations, nonprofits, or regulated entities
  • Familiarity with grant management, charitable finance, or governance structures
  • Experience working with global or enterpriselevel budgets
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or similar financial analysis tools


Tools Systems

  • Financial tracking and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Quickbooks)
  • Proficiency in using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, M365, Claude, Amethyst, etc.)
  • Collaboration and documentation tools (e.g., Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
  • Experience with enterprise finance or reporting systems is a plus


Additional Information

  • This role does not include people management responsibilities
  • Regular collaboration with global stakeholders is required
  • Work hours will align with U.S. or EMEA time zones (second shift preferred)

title: Manager, Privacy Engineering & Data Protection Compliance
jobDescription:
Job Summary
The Manager- Privacy Engineering Data Protection Compliance sits within the Data Privacy Office (DPO), part of Equinixs Legal organisation, and is responsible for ensuring that data protection and privacy obligations are effectively implemented and operationalised across systems, processes, and business operations.
This role is technical and delivery-focused and will serve as a critical link between the Data Privacy Office (DPO), the Digital Innovation Organization (DIO) (particularly Information Security (InfoSec)), and other business functions across Equinix.
The successful candidate will:
  • Work with the DPO to translate legal and regulatory requirements into actionable technical and operational solutions
  • Support and drive the embedding of privacy-by-design, data governance, and AI governance into technology and business processes
  • Enable the development of scalable frameworks, controls, and tools to support compliance
  • Contribute to ongoing monitoring, KPI tracking, and audit-readiness of privacy and data protection controls
This role will act as the bridge between legal and technical teams to ensure that regulatory requirements are implemented in a practical, measurable, and sustainable way, enabling both compliance and innovation.
Responsibilities
Privacy Engineering, Compliance Implementation
  • Work with DPO to translate regulatory and legal requirements (e.g. GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, India DPDP Act, China PIPL, and other global privacy laws) into technical controls, system requirements, and operational processes
  • Lead and/or contribute to the design, creation, and continuous refinement of privacy, data protection, and security-related processes, standards, and policies to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and operational needs
  • Support and drive implementation of Privacy by Design across products, platforms, and internal systems
  • Partner with engineering, InfoSec, and product teams to embed privacy requirements into system architecture, development lifecycles, and operational workflows
  • Define, implement, and maintain technical and organisational measures (TOMs) aligned to legal obligations
  • Conduct and support hands-on technical evaluations, including: data flow analysis, system and architecture reviews, privacy impact/risk assessments
  • Contribute to the development of standardised patterns, guardrails, and reusable solutions for privacy compliance
Data Governance Lifecycle Management
  • Support and help drive implementation of data governance frameworks, including: data lifecycle management, data classification
  • Partner with business and technical teams to map data flows, processing activities, and system dependencies
  • Support development and simplification of operational controls
  • Enable consistent implementation of data handling standards across the enterprise
Data Security
  • Partner with InfoSec to ensure privacy requirements are embedded within data security controls and practices
  • Support compliance alignment with security frameworks and standards (e.g. ISO 27001, NIST)
  • Contribute to third-party risk management, vendor onboarding, and data security reviews
  • Support implementation of privacy-enhancing technologies (e.g. data masking, minimisation)
AI Governance Responsible Data Use
  • Support and help drive implementation of AI governance frameworks, including policies, controls, and risk management practices
  • Translate legal and regulatory requirements relating to AI and automated decision-making into operational controls and guidance
  • Support responsible and compliant use of personal data in AI systems
  • Contribute to development of training, FAQs, and business guidance for AI usage
Data Privacy Program Enablement (Operationalisation)
  • Support and contribute to implementation of the organisations data privacy compliance program, including: privacy policies, standards, and procedures, data protection impact assessments (DPIAs)
  • Support responses to customer, vendor, and regulatory data protection queries
Incident Management Regulatory Support
  • Support privacy incident management processes, including coordination with cybersecurity teams
  • Contribute to incident assessments, escalation processes, and regulatory reporting inputs
  • Help define and refine roles, responsibilities, and handoffs between privacy and security incident processes
  • Support continuous improvement of incident response frameworks
Stakeholder Engagement Collaboration

title: Senior Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Job Title : Senior Data Scientist Summary:

The Senior Data Scientist - Knowledge Representation is a core technical role on the Healthcare Supply Chain (HCSC) Knowledge Representation (KR) team. This role brings machine learning, data science, and AI capabilities directly in service of knowledge representation problems: entity resolution, knowledge graphs, embedding-based semantic alignment, LLM-assisted knowledge extraction, and validation of ontological claims against data.

Our platform connects hospitals, distributors, GPOs, manufacturers, and regulators, enabling transactional execution, clinical data alignment, and analytics optimization across organizational boundaries. Each party encodes its own implicit knowledge about the world in its schemas, identifiers, and workflows. The KR teams job is to make that implicit knowledge explicit, alignable, and trustworthy.

Essential Duties:

  • Design and implement knowledge representation solutions that balance performance and costs: using a variety of data stores (graph, document, tabular, vector).
  • Design, build, and maintain entity resolution systems.
  • Develop and own embedding-based and hybrid semantic similarity solutions.
  • Build and operate LLM-assisted knowledge extraction pipelines that identify ontological candidates from unstructured and semi-structured HCSC data sources.
  • Design and implement uncertainty quantification frameworks for KR outputs: confidence scoring for entity resolution decisions, calibration of alignment scores, and propagation of data quality signals through KR pipelines so that downstream consumers understand the reliability of what they receive.
  • Partner with data quality engineers to establish bidirectional feedback channels between KR pipeline failures and systematic data quality issues.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Stay current with developments in AI, ML and Data Science including knowledge graph embeddings, neuro-symbolic AI, and AI reasoning.

Competencies:

  • Strong ML engineering fundamentals: experience designing, training, evaluating, and operating models in production.
  • Genuine engagement with knowledge representation concepts: sufficient familiarity with OWL, description logics, and ontological commitments to reason about what an ML models outputs actually assert.
  • Understanding and expertise in embedding methods for knowledge graphs and text with practical experience applying them to similarity, matching, and alignment tasks, and understanding of their failure modes in sparse or structurally heterogeneous domains.
  • Practical LLM engineering skills: prompt engineering for structured extraction, fine-tuning or adapter methods for domain adaptation, retrieval-augmented generation for KR tasks, and rigorous evaluation of LLM outputs.
  • Proficiency in knowledge graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, property graphs) at a working level sufficient to query, evaluate, and annotate KR structures.
  • Excellent cross-disciplinary communication: able to explain statistical model behavior and uncertainty to stakeholders.
  • Comfort operating at the boundary of statistical and formal methods.
  • Requires minimal supervision on ML and data science work within the KR domain.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Greater than 4 years of applied ML and data science experience, with at least some portion of that work directly involving entity resolution, semantic matching, knowledge graph construction, or related knowledge representation problems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-assisted knowledge extraction: prompt design, structured output parsing, domain fine-tuning or few-shot adaptation.
  • Working knowledge of RDF and SPARQL.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement model evaluation frameworks.
  • Strong programming skills for ML pipeline development, data analysis, and tooling; proficiency with the standard ML stack (e.g. PyTorch or equivalent, HuggingFace, scikit-learn) and with graph data tooling (RDFLib, NetworkX, or equivalent).
  • Experience working in multi-disciplinary settings where ML outputs feed into formal systems or decision-making processes.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelors or advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Computational Linguistics, Information Science, or a related discipline; graduate work in knowledge representation, NLP, or information extraction is a strong plus.
  • Experience with neurosymbolic AI approaches: methods that combine learned representations with formal reasoning, constraint satisfaction, or logic-based inference - particularly in the context of knowledge graph completion, ontology alignment, or structured prediction tasks.
  • Healthcare supply chain domain knowledge.
  • Familiarity with OWL 2 and description logics at a reading level: not required to author axioms independently, but able to read OWL and understand what a reasoner computes.
  • Experience with graph database platforms at production scale.

We are looking for an Applied AI Engineer to help build the systems that make our AI agents powerful, reliable, and useful in real-world cybersecurity environments. You will build the backend infrastructure that powers our agents while also working directly on agent behavior, improving how agents reason, use tools, retrieve context, handle failures, and complete complex tasks. The goal isn't simply to build models or backend services in isolation. It's to turn AI capabilities into dependable production systems that solve real customer problems. jobDescription:
We are Omnissa.

Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from anywhere experiences. What is the opportunity

You have an analytical mind and a passion for the craft of software engineering, and you love solving problems and learning new things. Technologies come and go, but that excites you because of the endless possibilities it creates.

You are looking for an opportunity to work for a company whose software is utilized by every Fortune 500 company and significantly impacts every industry. You want to be a part of a collaborative environment whose teams care about the product they are creating, how they create it, and the impact it has on customers business objectives.

As a Member of Technical Staff, you will be responsible for:

  • Identify and troubleshoot performance, scalability, and code quality issues across application, ingestion, and data layers.

  • Perform code reviews and ensure coding best practices.

What will you bring to Omnissa

You are expected to have strong experience in the following:

  • Deep hands-on experience with ClickHouse table design for analytical workloads: sorting key and sparse primary key design; partition strategy; data skipping indexes; materialized views for pre-aggregation; codec and compression selection per column type; and TTL policies for retention and data tiering.

  • Proven experience operating ClickHouse in production: distributed cluster design with ClickHouse Keeper; sharding and Distributed table architecture; high-throughput ingestion patterns; query profiling; diagnosing merge backpressure, part explosion, and mutation storms; memory and thread tuning via server/user profiles; storage tiering with storage policies; and monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana using ClickHouse-native metrics.

  • Familiarity with ClickHouse projections, query result caching, RBAC and row-level security, and experience managing version upgrades across breaking changes.

  • Strong understanding of analytical data modeling and trade-offs between transactional and analytical storage patterns.

  • Experience building or supporting high-throughput ingestion pipelines involving streaming systems, asynchronous processing, batch loading, or change-data-capture style workflows.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, especially where it is used as a transactional state store alongside an analytical database.

  • High proficiency and experience in Unix/Linux platforms.

  • Strong working experience with C#, Go, and Docker.

  • Good understanding of and experience in software architecture and high-performance, scalable distributed systems.

  • Solid grasp of application architecture, networking, security, reliability, and scalability concepts.

  • Strong DevOps experience, including building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

  • Collaboration skills for working with distributed teams (Omnissa has teams globally).

  • 2-10 years of experience in software engineering.

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent technical training

Additionally, the following skills and qualifications will help you stand out :

  • Hands-on experience with Kafka, including event-driven or streaming architectures beyond basic pub/sub.

  • Experience designing systems for non-blocking ingestion, asynchronous processing, internal queueing, file-based loaders, or decoupled write pipelines.

  • Experience with large-scale JOIN-heavy analytical workloads and query patterns that require predictable low-latency responses.

  • Comprehensive knowledge and work experience with any or all of the following technologies: Redis, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and OpenSearch.

  • Strong foundation in Linux file systems, memory, and multi-threading.

  • Experience maintaining a large number of production deployments.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS Cloud solutions and managed cloud services.

  • Working knowledge of infrastructure technologies such as OS (Linux and Windows), Network, Database, Server, Storage, etc.

By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.


Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.

About M&G


Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.


Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.


Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.


The Technology Governance Risk and Controls (GRC) function provides oversight of policy, standards, risks and controls across different areas. The function drives a better understanding of first line risks and will support, advise and facilitate the leadership team in actively managing risk by making decisions regarding the need for remedial actions and/or risk acceptances taking into account:

The current First Line GRC risk profile and control environment;
The relative scale of exposure and their likelihood; and
The cost and effort of remediating those exposures.

The policies and control frameworks managed by the team include Information Technology, Operational Resilience, Third Party Risk Management, Data and Privacy.

The primary role of the AVP is to perform control testing across Third Party Risk Management, Operational Resilience, Data & Privacy areas and support the development and improvements of the control framework across all areas managed by TGRC to ensure that it remains aligned to the M&G risk appetite. This includes, but is not limited to, understanding the external requirements (by regulators and industry bodies) and the organisation s strategy, vision and direction, external and internal emerging risk, and working closely with other leads in the function and wider M&G to understand the control framework and recommend improvements of policy, standards and control requirements. This will include overall assessment of the implementation of the control framework and will be supporting control owners to define corrective actions when gaps are identified. In addition, the role will support oversight of the Technology controls testing team and the issue assurance process providing validation of issue closure packs.

Performing control testing across the Technology, Third Party Risk Management, Operational Resilience, Data & Privacy functions
Ensuring our stakeholders are integrated and work consistently across GRC and relevant M&G plc risk framework, policies, processes and ways of working.

Experience of third party relationships and the Information Technology and security risks created.

title: Senior Incident Response Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Sophos is seeking an experienced and motivated Incident Response Consultant to join our Incident Response (IR) service. The Sophos IR team is an elite group of incident responders that are engaged by organizations worldwide to respond to and neutralize cyber threats. Specializing in industry-standard forensic tools and Sophos technologies, the team provides comprehensive investigations, response actions, remediation guidance, and root cause analysis to combat a wide range of cybersecurity incidents.

As a Senior Incident Response Consultant on the Sophos IR team, you will be responsible for spearheading incident response engagements for customers who have experienced a cybersecurity attack. In this role, you will lead a team of Incident Response Consultants, running customer-facing calls, providing detailed written updates via email, and determining the priorities of the investigation, delegating tasks accordingly to your team.

In this role, you will be accountable for ensuring that the appropriate actions have been taken by both your team and the customer to effectively neutralize the threat. Additionally, you will be tasked with conducting a thorough root cause analysis to determine the origin of the incident, including identifying whether any data exfiltration occurred, provided the necessary evidence is available.

At the culmination of each engagement, you will be responsible for producing an executive summary-style report, which will include a timeline of key events mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework. This comprehensive report will serve as a valuable resource for stakeholders, highlighting the steps taken to combat the cybersecurity incident and provide remediation guidance.

The ideal candidate for this role will possess extensive experience leading incident response efforts, a deep understanding of cybersecurity threats and mitigation strategies, and the ability to communicate complex technical information to executive-level stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

What you will do

  • Lead kick off calls with customers to understand their situation and identify initial response actions to contain the threat
  • Provide guidance to customers on best practices following an incident
  • Lead daily update calls for customers to deliver forensic findings
  • Deliver concise email updates to customers between update calls
  • Direct the forensic investigations, identify priorities, and delegate tasks to analysts
  • Conduct multiple Rapid Response incidents concurrently
  • Determine TTPs identified by analysts and add them to the threat intel platform
  • Write clear and concise Executive Summary style reports in a timely manner
  • Responsible for basic to moderate complexity projects that contribute to the development of the Sophos Rapid Response service
  • Provide daily handover notes to teams located in different time zones, or when incident responsibility is being transferred to another Incident Lead

What you will bring

  • 5+ years of experience leading incident response investigations involving ransomware
  • Experience leading BEC investigations
  • Continuously learning and staying informed of the changing threat landscape
  • Proven track record of successful neutralization and remediation of ransomware threats
  • Excellent understanding of the Incident Response process
  • Excellent understanding of cyber risks and able to qualify them to customers
  • Excellent oral communication skills
  • Strong written communication skills
  • Ability to manage time effectively
  • Able to delegate and prioritize tasks across multiple incidents
  • Able to excel under stressful circumstances
  • Occasionally willing to begin work early and/or stay late when warranted for customer engagements
  • Strong grasp of the MITRE ATT&CK framework
  • Enjoy mentoring and assisting in the development of junior analysts
  • A team-player attitude with a willingness to share knowledge
  • Ability to work on weekends and holidays
  • Post-secondary education in Cybersecurity, comparable
  • Desirable: Cybersecurity certifications an asset (e.g. CISSP, GCFA, or similar)
  • Experience with SIEM technology (e.g. Splunk, ELK, etc.)
  • Willingness to work occasional overtime during peak times or holidays
  • Experience writing SQL queries
  • Experience writing PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripts

At SSC, we are embarking on an exciting journey to reimagine software engineering through Artificial Intelligence, and were looking for an experienced AI Engineer to help lead that transformation.

Join our dynamic team at EvenDigit, a leading digital marketing agency under Softude, a CMMI Level 5 Company. Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute comprehensive Google Ads strategies aligned with client objectives.
  • Collaborate with team members to implement and refine strategies for optimal performance.
  • Create, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across various platforms (search, display, video, shopping).

  • Maintain strong client relationships through regular updates and performance reviews.
  • Adjust strategies based on client feedback and changing business needs.
  • Guide and mentor junior team members, fostering a collaborative and productive environment. Conduct training sessions to keep the team updated on the latest trends and best practices in Google Ads.
  • Oversee Google Ads projects to ensure timely and budget-compliant completion.
  • Utilize project management tools for tracking and reporting.
  • Define KPIs and monitor campaign performance using analytics tools. Provide regular, actionable performance reports to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Apply innovative approaches to enhance campaign performance.
  • Address and resolve client concerns promptly and effectively. Troubleshoot technical issues related to ad delivery, tracking, or account setup.
  • Identify and act on opportunities for upselling and cross-selling Google Ads services.
  • Assist in pre-sales activities and create supportive case studies and portfolios.
  • Meet training targets and apply new knowledge to projects. Encourage team participation in company activities for better collaboration.

Experience

  • Holding 4 - 5 years of hands-on experience in managing Google Ads campaigns.

Technical qualification and skills

  • Proficiency in Google Ads dashboard and other tools like Google Data Studio, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Proficiency with computers. Well-versed with MS Office, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.
  • Proven track record of driving successful Google Ads campaigns and achieving KPIs.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues related to ad delivery, tracking, or account setup.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and optimize campaigns based on insights.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing methodologies and campaign optimization strategies.
  • In-depth knowledge of Google Ads platform, including search, display, shopping, video, and app campaigns.
  • Experience in conducting thorough keyword research and competitive analysis using tools like Google Keyword Planner, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Moz.
  • Expertise in implementing bid adjustments, ad copy testing, and landing page improvements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
  • Commitment to staying updated with the latest trends, best practices, and technologies in Google Ads and digital marketing.
  • Proven experience in managing client relationships and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.
  • Proficiency in project management tools such as Basecamp, Trello, or Asana to manage tasks, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Ability to oversee multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely and budget compliant completion.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelors degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field (required).
  • Master s degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
  • Google Ads certification (required).
  • Additional certifications in digital marketing, such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, or HubSpot (preferred).
  • Meta and Amazon Advertisement experience is a plus
  • Continuous education through industry-recognized programs, webinars, and workshops to stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends and technologies (preferred).

Soft skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to convey complex ideas clearly and persuasively.
  • Strong leadership skills to inspire and guide team members towards achieving goals.
  • Strong problem-solving skills to identify issues quickly and implement effective solutions.
  • Exceptional time management and organizational skills to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Strong client management skills to build and maintain long-term relationships.
  • High attention to detail to ensure accuracy and quality in campaign execution and reporting.
  • Proactive in identifying opportunities for improvement and driving continuous innovation.

Growth Opportunity

  • Onsite opportunities for working directly with clients or attending industry events and conferences.
  • Defined career growth path with clear milestones and progression plans.
  • Continuous learning and skill development opportunities through training sessions, workshops, and certifications.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge digital marketing tools and technologies.
  • Opportunities to lead and mentor a growing team, enhancing leadership skills.
  • Participation in strategic decision-making processes and high-impact projects.
  • Networking opportunities with industry experts and thought leaders.
  • Access to resources for staying updated with the latest trends and best practices in Google Ads and digital marketing.

Work Location

  • Indore

Option for Hybrid Working

The purpose of this role is practical application of data science in supply chain planning and inventory management to improve underlaying processes and deliver financial value.

To succeed in this role, you must have multidisciplinary skill set - proven experience in project management and SC planning, knowledge of planning systems (SAP APO/IBP, OM Partners or similar), SAP architecture (underlying tables, transactions) and strong technical and analytical skills.

In this creative role you will have unique opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders in the global organization working on various improvement initiatives, development of analytical tools, optimization models or supply chain simulations and you need to feel comfortable in each stage of this process (design, develop and deploy) to thrive and succeed.

You are self-starter with hands-on approach and continues improvement mindset working on your own initiative under moderate supervision. You know how to source and use data together with statistical methods and technology to improve processes. It is important you have theoretical knowledge but more important you understand how to use it in practice to add value.

Your nearest assignments will focus on portfolio segmentation, product life cycle management, development of replenishment strategies and inventory optimization within distribution network. All contributing to development of planning tool supporting decision making process for planning teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Supply Chain Management or APICS CPIM certification and 5-7+ years experience in Global Supply Chain and Inventory Management essential (multi-site, multi-region),
  • Degree or certification in Data Science desirable,
  • Formal Project Management and problem-solving training desirable, e.g., Six Sigma, Lean.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Demonstrated ability to select and work with appropriate analytical tools and software (Excel, PBI, relevant libraries in R and Python or SQL) and build ETL pipelines,
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Codex, to accelerate data analysis, code development, documentation, troubleshooting, and creation of analytical tools while applying appropriate validation and governance,
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, data quality, business relevance, bias, and operational feasibility before applying them to supply chain planning, inventory optimization, or decision-support processes,
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and visualize findings,
  • Demonstrated ability to wrangle, cleanse and model data from various sources (SAP, .csv, .xlsx, .txt, .parquet, .rds, data lake etc.),
  • Proficient in Excel and Power BI (Power Query/M, DAX, relational database model, data visualization); Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification is a plus,
  • Knowledge of SQL and R/Python highly desirable,
  • Experience working with data warehouse/data lake desirable (experience with Snowflake a plus),
  • Knowledge of Statistics and Machine Learning or strong willingness to quickly develop in this area.

Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and to prioritise actions for maximum impact.

Ability to develop and deploy short-term tools and reporting capabilities (with quantified accuracy and precision) essential.

Solid written and verbal communication skills, experience in a matrix environment desirable.

Environmental Working Conditions

Typically works in an office environment with adequate lighting and ventilation and a normal range of temperature and noise level.

Work assignments are diversified. Examples of past precedent are used to resolve work problems.

Most aspects of work are timebound and fit into a standard reporting cycle based on the monthly financial reporting calendar. There is an ongoing requirement to work to deadlines and to manage competing priorities.

Minimal physical effort is required. Work is mostly sedentary but does require walking, standing, bending, reaching, lifting or carrying objects that typically weigh less than 10 lbs.

jobDescription:
We re looking for a Senior AI Platform Engineer (Agent Framework Lead) to design and lead the development of a next-generation agent framework for AI-driven systems.

In this role, you will define how agents are built, orchestrated, and executed at scale - across multiple runtimes and frameworks. The focus is on creating reusable abstractions, standardizing patterns, and enabling reliable multi-agent workflows using modern tooling such as LangGraph, Strands, and AWS Bedrock AgentCore.

You ll operate at the intersection of platform engineering and applied AI, shaping how agent-based systems are built, deployed, and observed across the organization.

What project we have for you

Our customer is a multinational corporation with more than a century of history and offices in over 180 countries. Their most ambitious goal at the time is to introduce a range of Reduced-Risk Products (RRPs). The target audience is more than 1 billion consumers around the globe. IT platform hosts 700+ applications.
Intellia s mission is to help the client with the engineering of a comprehensive software ecosystem for a game-changing IoT product on the margin of innovative consumer experience and cutting-edge technology. Our teams are involved in the engineering of core platform components for best-in-class eCommerce, Digital Marketing and IoT solutions. As an Engineer, you will become a part of Core Architecture Team and be responsible for the architecture, implementation of best practices in our Digital Engineering Enterprise Platform.
The Platform is a set of services and internet applications that accelerate the development and delivery of software applications by taking care of common SDLC challenges. The Platform provides access and consumption for engineering teams to a set of services, technologies, practices for their development and for operating their application, ensuring a set of compliance and best practices.
Project is in production for 2+ years, being supported by multiple teams.

Our technical domains are:
- AWS cloud, partially Azure
- SSO, Organizations, Service control policies, access models.
- IAAC: terraform enterprise, terratest, chalice
- Serverless: lambda, step functions, wide range of misc automations, fargate
- System, Application, Network and security architectures
- Orchecstration: k8s (eks)
- SRE activities (logging, tracing, monitoring), OpsGenie, Splunk
- Hashicorp Vault
- Hybrid Networking

What you will do
  • Lead the design and development of agent frameworks and SDKs using LangGraph, Strands, or similar tools
  • Define and implement multi-agent orchestration patterns (ReAct, supervisor, A2A delegation, hierarchical flows)
  • Design and evolve agent execution flows using Bedrock AgentCore Runtime and related AWS services
  • Implement and standardize MCP / A2A protocols for agent communication and tool integration
  • Develop declarative configuration systems (YAML + Pydantic schemas) for agent behavior and workflows
  • Ensure cross-framework compatibility, supporting multiple agent runtimes (e.g., LangGraph and Strands)
  • Integrate observability and tracing using OpenTelemetry (ADOT, X-Ray, CloudWatch)
  • Collaborate with platform and AI teams to define best practices and reusable patterns
  • Contribute to internal framework governance, documentation, and developer experience
  • Provide technical leadership in shaping the agent platform architecture
What you need for this

- LangGraph (create_react_agent, StateGraph, ToolNode)
- Strands Agents SDK (StrandsA2AExecutor, @tool decorator)
- AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime (BedrockAgentCoreApp, invocation lifecycle)
- MCP / A2A protocol design (langchain-mcp-adapters, SigV4 signing)
- Declarative config patterns (YAML-driven Pydantic schemas)
- Multi-agent orchestration patterns (ReAct, supervisor, A2A delegation)
- aws-opentelemetry-distro (ADOT traces to X-Ray + CloudWatch)
Experience:
- 5+ years Python engineering
- Production experience with LangGraph or Strands Agents (or equivalent)
- AWS Bedrock or AgentCore Runtime deployment experience
- Designed or contributed to an internal agent framework or SDK
- Multi-agent coordination patterns (supervisor, swarm, hierarchical)
Will be a plus:
- Experience with both LangGraph and Strands (dual-framework strategy)
- bedrock-agentcore SDK internals and agentcore.json deployment config
- Open-source AI/LLM tooling contributions

This role is a remote contractual role. Our work time will be from 1-10 PM IST.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) across the cluster nodes.

  • Apply OS and platform patches, security updates, and OpenShift version upgrades in a controlled, low-downtime manner.

  • Manage node lifecycle operations (cordon/drain, reboot, replacement, scaling) within OpenShift.

  • Maintain and troubleshoot underlying Dell server hardware (PowerEdge or similar), including firmware updates (iDRAC), RAID/storage controllers, and network interfaces.

  • Coordinate with the colocation facility in Nebraska for remote hands support, power, cooling, and physical access needs.

  • Monitor hardware health (disk, memory, power supplies) and manage vendor support cases/warranty claims with Dell and IBM.

  • Manage OpenShift cluster components: control plane, etcd, networking (SDN/OVN), storage classes, and ingress/routing.

  • Administer container registries, projects/namespaces, RBAC, and resource quotas.

  • Monitor cluster health using OpenShift-native tooling (cluster monitoring stack, Prometheus/Grafana) and respond to alerts.

  • Support the IBM Watson deployment (IBM Cloud Pak for Data / "Fusion" stack) running on top of OpenShift, including operator health, storage-backed services, and application pods.

  • Work with IBM support and documentation to troubleshoot Watson/Fusion-specific issues, apply IBM-provided patches/fix packs, and manage license entitlements.

  • Coordinate planned maintenance windows and upgrades for the Watson/Fusion layer with minimal service disruption.

  • Manage persistent storage backing the cluster (e.g., ODF/Ceph, NFS, or SAN-attached storage, depending on the environment).

  • Implement and test backup/disaster recovery procedures for cluster configuration, etcd, and application data.

  • Maintain network configuration for the private data center environment, including VLANs, firewalls, and load balancers as applicable.

  • Apply security hardening in line with Red Hat and IBM best practices; manage certificates, secrets, and access controls.

  • Maintain audit logs and support compliance/security review processes as required by the organization.

  • Set up and maintain monitoring/alerting for cluster and application health.

  • Diagnose and resolve incidents, performing root cause analysis and driving remediation.

  • Document cluster architecture, runbooks, and standard operating procedures (this is especially important given the current environment is not well-documented internally).

Required Skills Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) in production environments.

  • Solid working experience with Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform administration (cluster operations, oc/kubectl, operators, RBAC, networking).

  • Experience with bare-metal server hardware administration (Dell PowerEdge preferred), including iDRAC, firmware, and RAID management.

  • Familiarity with container and Kubernetes fundamentals (pods, deployments, persistent volumes, namespaces).

  • Experience working in or supporting a private/on-premises data center or colocation environment (as opposed to purely public cloud).

  • Understanding of enterprise storage concepts (SAN/NAS, Ceph/ODF, or similar) as used in OpenShift persistent storage.

  • Comfort with Linux networking (firewalls, VLANs, DNS, load balancing/ingress).

  • Strong troubleshooting and incident response skills, with the ability to work independently in an environment with limited existing documentation.

  • Good written communication skills for documentation and vendor coordination (Dell, IBM, Red Hat support).

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Direct experience with IBM Cloud Pak for Data, IBM Watson, or IBM Fusion/Fusion HCI appliances.

  • Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration (RHCSA/RHCE + OpenShift certs).

  • Experience with Ansible for configuration management and automation.

  • Familiarity with IBM Storage Fusion / IBM Spectrum or similar hyper-converged infrastructure.

  • Experience managing vendor support relationships (Dell ProSupport, IBM Support, Red Hat subscriptions).

  • Prior experience in a regulated or high-availability environment where uptime and data locality (private, non-cloud hosting) are critical.

Role Overview

We are seeking a motivated and driven DFT Engineers to join our semiconductor design team. In this role, you will take direct ownership of implementing and verifying Design-for-Test (DFT) features across complex SoCs and ASICs. You will drive tasks independently to ensure high test coverage, manufacturability, and first-pass silicon quality.This is a great opportunity to build world-class chiplets and work on cutting-edge silicon architectures.


What You ll Do

  • Execute scan insertion, scan chain stitching, and DFT rule checking (DRC) using industry-standard tools.
  • Generate and simulate ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) patterns targeting stuck-at and transition fault models.
  • Implement and verify MBIST (Memory Built-In Self-Test) structures for embedded memories.
  • Deploy and validate JTAG and Boundary Scan (BSCAN/IEEE 1149.1) architectures at the chip level.
  • Run gate-level DFT simulations and perform detailed coverage analysis to close test gaps.
  • Debug silicon bring-up failures by analyzing test data logs and isolating physical defects.

  • Own the documentation of DFT architecture implementation details and post-silicon test procedures.

  • Demonstrated experience with basic ATPG, MBIST, scan compression, and fault modeling.
  • Direct exposure running Synopsys (TestMAX), Siemens (Tessent), or Cadence DFT EDA tools.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and cross-functional communication skills.


Good to Have

  • Practical knowledge of IJTAG (IEEE 1687) architectures.
  • Proficiency in writing scripts using Tcl, Python, or Perl to automate DFT tool flows.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible.
